notes.title: August 5, 2025 Bug Fixes
notes.content: [list][*][p]Fixed a bug preventing bosses from properly absorbing blood at lower framerates[/p][/*][*][p]Increased sound and mouse sens increments in the options menus to 5 and 0.05 respectively[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where skipping the last cutscene through the pause menu would skip the credits[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug that made the mouse cursor visible during the credits[/p][/*][/list][p]These changes have also been applied to the demo version of the game.[/p]
